text: Artificial Intelligence, or AI, is a technology that allows computers to think and learn like humans. One important part of AI is machine learning, where computers learn from data without being told every step. Deep learning is a more advanced type of machine learning that uses large neural networks to solve difficult problems. Today, AI is used in many parts of daily life. For example, it helps with voice assistants, movie recommendations, and even medical tests. AI is also used in self-driving cars and language translation apps. As AI grows, it will continue to change how we live and work.
